title.en: Repeated Concerns Regarding Front Desk Conduct

text.en: A majority of recent reviewers report serious dissatisfaction with the attitude, professionalism, and attentiveness of staff members. Pet owners describe encountering unhelpful and dismissive front desk receptionists, with one client alleging an employee yelled at their dog. Only one longtime patron praised individual staff members for caring support.

Reviewers express strong alarm over pet supervision and animal handling practices in the facility. Visitors report seeing an elderly dog in distress left unattended on a slippery elevated surface without prompt staff assistance. While a positive review noted thorough initial health screenings, multiple pet parents felt unsafe leaving their dogs.

Clients report persistent communication breakdowns regarding appointments, service policies, and membership perks. Reviewers cite receiving conflicting phone instructions about drop-in daycare and sudden cancellation of promotional grooming sessions without adequate accommodation.

q.en: Does the facility require a temperament test before daycare?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that dogs must undergo a temperament test and provide verified vaccine documentation prior to daycare admission.

q.en: What do pet parents report about staff supervision in the playrooms?

a.en: Recent reviews raise concerns regarding staff attentiveness and prompt monitoring of vulnerable or elderly dogs in daycare areas.

q.en: How does the business handle grooming appointment reschedules?

a.en: Clients report rigid rescheduling policies when promotional or membership grooming appointments are canceled by the salon.
